line_items.reasoning: Q3 total revenue of $6.5B (+25% YoY) exceeded the guided ~10% higher entry run rate (with HPS); HPS delivered ~$225M in management fees (in line) plus an additional ~$270M in performance fees, and record ETF inflows drove 10% annualized organic base fee growth — the strongest quarter since 2021, clearly surpassing the guided trajectory.

As-adjusted operating margin came in at 44.6%, falling short of the 45%+ target guided for over the cycle, with the 120 bps YoY decline driven by higher performance fee-related compensation and M&A onboarding costs — the near-term pressure materialized more acutely than the 'clear path' framing implied.
The ~25% tax rate, at-least-$375M/quarter share repurchase commitment, and 40%-50% dividend payout ratio targets were all reaffirmed this quarter with no indication of deviation from prior guidance.

HPS's ~$225M in management fees matched guidance exactly, but the additional ~$270M in performance fees in its first full quarter was a significant upside surprise; GIP V closing above its $25B target and record $13.5T AUM with $205B net inflows also exceeded the guided positive HPS fee rate impact and private markets fundraising trajectory.
